servinfo.title: Treatment of Flat Tire Repaired with Sealant

attention1.ptxt: Damage to health may result if you do not observe the precautions when handling flat tire repaired with flat tire repair sealant.
Observe the precautions in Precautions for Emergency Flat Tire Repair Kit (If Equipped) when handling the flat tire.

s1.ptxt: Remove wheel and tire repaired with the sealant.
Release air from the tire slowly by loosening valve core.
For vehicle without TPMS, pull valve stem and cut rubber (1) of the valve to thereby let remainder portion (2) drop into inside of the wheel.
For vehicle with TPMS, remove the pressure sensor mounting nut (3) to thereby let the pressure sensor (4) drop into inside of the wheel.
Remove the tire from the wheel using tire changer.

attention3.ptxt: Remove the tire carefully not to spill sealant in the tire.

s1.ptxt: Remove flat tire repair sealant from the tire and wipe off remaining sealant from the tire and the wheel.
Replace the tire with new one. However, if the tire damage is slight and the puncture is judged to be repairable, repair it.
Install a new tire pressure sensor to wheel.
Install new or repaired tire to wheel and check that no leakage exists, and then adjust tire pressure to the specification.
For vehicle without TPMS, install a new valve to wheel.
For vehicle with TPMS, install wheel fitted with tire to vehicle.
